summary: Expose all nested QA V2 semantic invariants in the QA V3 prompt and retain a bounded validator category when a decision is rejected.
decision_refs: S1 failed the QA V3 contract through both experimental vision and text routes
S2 independently failed the same contract through the text route
The QA V3 prompt omitted exact answer/claim concatenation and other validator-only QA V2 rules that the QA V2 prompt already states
approval_evidence: The user approved continued implementation and rerunning the fixed Reference evaluation while retaining existing product paths.
known_limitations: Prompt alignment improves contract legibility but does not guarantee model compliance or engineering correctness.
Safe validator categories intentionally do not retain the rejected model payload, so some failures remain coarsely classified.
Existing settled error calls remain immutable and are not eligible for automatic retry.
